caption:
Great round, stiff back the next morning? Golf asks your lower back, hips and mid-back to turn hard again and again, on top of walking hills and bending for the ball.

Remedial massage around the hips, glutes and lower back can ease stiffness and make turning feel more comfortable. Keep deeper sessions a few days out from a round or the day after, with lighter work the day before. It complements strength and mobility work rather than replacing it, and a five-minute warm-up before the first tee helps too.

Back pain spreading into the leg or pins and needles is worth a physio assessment. Book online via the link in bio ⛳
